page.overview:
Who is Leane Sharif?

She has the copper skin of a Domani, and is thin and nearly as tall as a man. She is willowy, graceful, and beautiful. When Min meets her at Tar Valon, she describes her hair straight, dark and only a little longer than Min's own hair.

She lost her ageless look after being stilled, and looked about 23 years old.

As Keeper of the Chronicles, she was brisk and well-organized.

After being stilled and Healed, she was considered very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength of . Leane explains that she and Siuan were less than half their original strength and, had they even been as strong as half, "most [in Salidar] would be as strong, and a good many stronger". Siuan, with a strength level of , considered herself so weak that a "no more than middling" sister like Aeldene Stonebridge would expect her to be "holding my tongue until [she] give me permission to speak". Aeldene would be classed as no more than low average and we know of only a handful of Aes Sedai that are weaker than Leane.
